title: Mini Build: Save Then Load
prompt: The persistence cycle in one program: build a list of two dicts (task, done) for tasks "write report" (done) and "send email" (not done), save it to tasks.json, then load it back and print the COUNT of unfinished tasks (one line, just the number).

tests.name: unfinished count printed
tests.code:
assert printed[0] == "1", f"got {printed}"
import json as _j
with open("tasks.json", encoding="utf-8") as _f:
    _d = _j.load(_f)
assert isinstance(_d, list) and len(_d) == 2 and all("task" in t and "done" in t for t in _d), f"bad file {_d}"
tests.hint: save with json.dump; load with json.load; count entries where not done.
